title: SegPAR: Class-Centric Decision-Based Sparse Attack for Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.11285v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the practical relevance of sparse decision-based black-box threats, they have received limited attention in semantic segmentation. To bridge this gap, we adapt the most representative decision-based black-box sparse attacks from the classification domain to serve as baselines, establishing a rigorous benchmark for this underexplored setting. In this context, we demonstrate that one of the existing methods suffers from severe query inefficiency due to its image-centric pixel accumulation, which rapidly exhausts query budgets across the vast image space. To overcome this, we propose SegPAR, a novel decision-based framework that shifts to a class-centric exploration paradigm. Furthermore, to eliminate the misleading feedback generated by standard decision rewards during pixel accumulation, we introduce a novel discrepancy reward. translated_title: SegPAR：面向语义分割的基于类别的决策型稀疏攻击
translated_abstract: 摘要：尽管稀疏决策型黑盒威胁具有实际相关性，但在语义分割领域它们受到的关注有限。为弥补这一差距，我们将分类领域中最具代表性的决策型黑盒稀疏攻击方法改编为基线，为这一研究不足的场景建立了严格的基准。在此背景下，我们证明现有方法之一因采用以图像为中心的像素累积策略而遭受严重的查询效率低下问题，这会在广阔的图像空间中迅速耗尽查询预算。为克服这一挑战，我们提出SegPAR，一种新颖的决策型框架，转向以类别为中心的探索范式。此外，为消除标准决策奖励在像素累积过程中产生的误导性反馈，我们引入了一种新颖的差异奖励机制。大量实验表明，SegPAR在稀疏性效率上显著优于黑盒基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出SegPAR，一种基于类别中心的决策型黑盒稀疏攻击框架，通过引入差异奖励机制，显著提升了语义分割任务中的查询效率和稀疏性攻击效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SegPAR, a class-centric decision-based sparse attack framework with a novel discrepancy reward, significantly improving query efficiency and sparsity efficacy in semantic segmentation.
